verdict.rationale: Multi-currency billing is a fair question for an invoicing product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers foreign-currency invoicing, per-currency price lists, exchange rates, or home-currency consolidated reporting. Support for 10+ languages, worldwide payment gateways, and general payment-pattern reports are adjacent features and do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can bill customers in their local currency with per-currency price points and consolidated reporting in my home currency
